description: Analogue percussion voice switchable between a soft bell and a clave, with voltage control of pitch, decay and level

params.text: Sets how long the voice rings on after a trigger
Sets the pitch of the voice
Sets how much louder a hit is when a gate is present at the ACCENT input as the voice is triggered
Chooses which voice the module makes, the soft bell or the clave
Attenuates the voltage at the FM input before it multiplies the pitch
Attenuates the voltage at the decay MOD input before it lengthens or shortens the decay
Sets the output level of the voice
Attenuates the voltage at the level MOD input before it raises or lowers the output level

inputs.text: A rising edge to 1V or more fires the voice
A gate of 1V or more here at the moment of a trigger makes that hit louder, by the amount set by the ACCENT knob
Voltage control of the pitch, scaled by the FM knob
Voltage control of the decay, scaled by the decay MOD knob
Voltage control of the output level, scaled by the level MOD knob

outputs.text: The voice, as a single audio signal

notes: no sound comes out of OUT until a trigger arrives at TRIG; the knobs shape a hit and none of them sounds on its own
